notice_decisions.name: http-serde
notice_decisions.rationale: The maintainer selected Apache-2.0 from the Apache-2.0 OR MIT grant in the original http-serde 2.1.1 manifest. Preserve the original source archive and author attribution and distribute the complete Apache-2.0 text. The archive has no LICENSE/NOTICE file; this source-specific selection does not approve redistribution of the entire image.

material_reviews.rationale: Approve distribution of this exact set of original source archives, original APT copyright/common-license notices and source-specific license decisions. Ship corresponding-source and original project-source archives with each binary image, including the complete signed Linux source, applied patches, configuration, recipes and dependency manifests. Preserve all original notices, including CDDL-1.0 inferno source, Unicode/data notices and the Apache-2.0 choice for http-serde. Source or notice changes invalidate this approval; it does not license the entire distribution under Apache-2.0. GPU firmware, proprietary drivers, model weights and external workload containers are excluded.
